moments.text: Colour sensor view with crosshair over flat dark scrubland crossed by dirt tracks and a straight road; the sensor pans so the ground streams past.
A tiny dark dot, only a few pixels wide, stays close to the crosshair, mostly just left of it, while the ground streams by.
The sensor swings away: the picture smears into blurred streaks, then settles on steep mountain slopes.
A wider view of steep, ridged mountain slopes in bluish light holds on the same area, drifting slowly.
The picture smears, goes black for 5 frames, then flashes white. Use frame step.
A wider view of brown, deeply folded mountain ridges follows, drifting slowly until the end.
